name: @activepieces/piece-kallabot-ai
description: AI-powered voice agents and conversational interfaces.

auth.description:
Follow these steps to obtain your Kallbot API Key:

1. Go to [Kallabot](https://kallabot.com/) and log in to your account.
2. Click on your profile picture in the top right corner.
3. Select **Settings** from the dropdown menu.
4. Navigate to the **API & Integrations** tab.
5. Copy the generated API key and paste it here.

make-call.name: make-call
make-call.description: Initiate an outbound call using Kallabot AI agent.

agent_id.description: Select the AI agent to use for the call.

recipient_phone_number.description: The phone number to call in E.164 format (e.g., +1234567890).

sender_phone_number.description: The phone number to make the call from.

template_variables.description: Variables to be used in the agent template (optional).

webhook_url.description: URL to receive call status updates (optional).

aiMetadata.description: Place a single outbound phone call where a Kallabot AI voice agent talks to the recipient. Use it for one-off calls (not bulk campaigns); requires an agent ID, a recipient number, and one of your account sender numbers, all in E.164 format. Each call placed is a new side effect, so this is not idempotent.

get-call-details.name: get-call-details
get-call-details.description: Retrieve details of a specific call by call SID.

call_sid.description: The unique identifier of the call.

aiMetadata.description: Look up the full record of one past or in-progress call by its call SID, including status, duration, cost, recording URL, and transcription. Use it to inspect or report on a known call. Read-only and idempotent.

get-contacts-from-list.name: get-contacts-from-list
get-contacts-from-list.description: Retrieve all contacts from a specific contact list.

list_id.description: Select the contact list to retrieve contacts from.

aiMetadata.description: List every contact stored in one Kallabot contact list, identified by its list ID. Use it to read or enumerate the members of a list before calling, editing, or campaigning. Read-only and idempotent.

edit-contact-list.name: edit-contact-list
edit-contact-list.description: Update/replace all contacts in an existing contact list.

list_id.description: Select the contact list to edit.

contacts.description: JSON array of contacts to replace the entire list

aiMetadata.description: Replace the entire contents of an existing contact list (by list ID) with a supplied array of contacts, each requiring a phone_number and optionally a name and template_variables. This is a full overwrite, not an append — contacts not in the array are removed; use Add Contacts to List to append instead. Idempotent: re-sending the same array yields the same resulting list.

add-contact-to-list.name: add-contact-to-list
add-contact-to-list.description: Add a contact or multiple contacts to an existing contact list.

list_id.description: Select the contact list to add contacts to.

contacts.description: JSON array of contacts to add to the list. Each contact must have phone_number and can include name and template_variables.

aiMetadata.description: Append one or more contacts to an existing contact list (by list ID); each contact requires a phone_number and may include a name and template_variables. Use it to grow a list without touching existing members; use Edit Contact List to fully replace the list instead. Not idempotent — repeating the call appends the contacts again.

name.description: The name of the contact list.

description.description: A description of the contact list (optional).

contacts.description: JSON array of contacts. Each contact must have phone_number and can include name, template_variables.

aiMetadata.description: Create a new named contact list seeded with an array of contacts, each requiring a phone_number and optionally a name and template_variables; an optional description can be set. Use it to set up a fresh list for calling or campaigns. Not idempotent — each call creates a separate new list even with identical input.

create-campaign.name: create-campaign
create-campaign.description: Create a new outbound calling campaign.

agent_id.description: Select the AI agent to use for the campaign.

list_id.description: Select the contact list for the campaign.

sender_phone_numbers.description: Select phone numbers to use for making calls.

delay_between_calls.description: Time to wait between calls in seconds.

scheduled_time.description: When to start the campaign (format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) ISO 8601.

timezone.description: Timezone for the scheduled time (e.g., America/New_York).

rotate_numbers_after.description: Number of contacts to call before rotating to the next phone number.

aiMetadata.description: Schedule a bulk outbound calling campaign that dials every contact in a list using a chosen AI agent and one or more sender numbers. Use it for mass calling rather than a single Make Call; requires an agent ID, a contact list ID, sender numbers, and a scheduled start time, with optional pacing controls (delay between calls, number rotation, timezone). Not idempotent — each call creates a separate campaign.

delete-campaign.name: delete-campaign
delete-campaign.description: Delete a campaign with optional contact list deletion.

campaign_id.description: The ID of the campaign to delete.

delete_contact_list.description: Also delete the associated contact list (optional).

aiMetadata.description: Permanently delete an outbound campaign by its campaign ID, optionally also deleting its associated contact list. Use it to clean up a campaign that is no longer needed; this is destructive. Idempotent in effect: once the campaign is gone, repeating the call leaves nothing further to delete.

catch_webhook.name: catch_webhook
catch_webhook.description: Receives webhook data when call events occur from Kallabot AI agents.

instructions.description:
**Setup Instructions:**
1. Copy the webhook URL below.
2. In your Kallabot AI agent configuration, go to Actions/Webhooks settings  .
3. Enable webhooks and paste the webhook URL.
4. Your agent will now send call data to this webhook when a call ends.

testInstructions.description:
**Test URL:**

If you want to generate sample data without triggering the flow, append `/test` to your webhook URL.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a Kallabot AI agent reports a call event via webhook, typically when a call ends, delivering the call details (status, duration, cost, recording, transcription, and transfer info) for that call. Requires the webhook URL to be configured in the Kallabot agent settings.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Hello, thank you for calling. How can I help you today?

conversation.speaker: customer
conversation.text: Hi, I need help with my account.

1. Go to [Kallabot](https://kallabot.com/) and log in to your account.
2. Click on your profile picture in the top right corner.
3. Select **Settings** from the dropdown menu.
4. Navigate to the **API & Integrations** tab.
5. Copy the generated API key and paste it here.
